theme: An open Saturday with the girls — the board waits for tomorrow.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan, and the girls are with you in St. Pete — a genuinely open Saturday. The weight is on the Dan & Mike board, where the trip and insurance items have gone overdue; tomorrow's 9 AM review is where they get cleared.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder is south until May, so there's no six-seater in Portland for Christmas week. Book a refundable full-size SUV at PWM now — holiday inventory is the thinnest of the year and sells out. On the board since Sept 14.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: All four girls, Dec 13–Jan 2. Both the decide-by (Sept 30) and book-by (Oct 15) dates have passed, so this is the one most at risk. Pick domestic vs. international and shortlist three.

needsAttention.title: Tee up the Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: The 15-minute review at 9 AM is the one thing that keeps the board honest. Arrive ready to put an owner and date on the Christmas rental, the December trip, and the life quotes — or kill what's gone stale.

flagged.title: LinkedIn invite from IFAC
flagged.detail: Bruce, an education and member-development director at IFAC, is waiting on your connection response — worth a look given the governance network.

flagged.title: Venmo request — $50 for mowing
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver requested $50 for the Oct 14 mow.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and promos — Italian words, Monocle, Trip.com, NFL Sunday Ticket, a salon notice.
inbox.clear: No email is actually waiting on your reply this morning.

acts.line: A clear start — breakfast with the girls and the garden, nothing on the calendar pulling at it.
The open stretch is yours; it's the natural place to break the back of the overdue trip planning.
Quiet tonight, but tomorrow opens early with Mike's 9 AM review and the island annual meeting at 5.
